name: e2e-competitor-benchmark
title: End-to-end competitor benchmark: WinForward AOT/JIT vs ProxiFyre/Proxifier/ProxyBridge
description: Build and run a real end-to-end benchmark on the Windows dev VM comparing the CI-built WinForward AOT and framework-dependent artifacts against ProxiFyre 2.6.1, Proxifier 4.14 and ProxyBridge 4.0.0 on latency, CPU, memory, UDP accuracy and TCP unexpected rate, through sing-box on loopback, with results and a report recorded under benchmarks/results/.
